subject: Model-fit gap analysis & evaluation plan (EU / APAC locales)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Martin <claudia.martin@linguamar.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Model-fit gap analysis & evaluation plan (EU / APAC locales)

Claudia — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned across product, engineering and procurement: 

Summary of discovery
- Primary goal: improve localized NLU (intent extraction + entity QA) across French, German, Japanese and Korean for customer-facing chat flows.
- Success metrics you called out: intent F1 >= 0.92 on core intents, entity extraction precision >= 0.9, and manual accept rate >= 92% for localized suggestions.
- Constraints: mixed residency requirements for EU accounts (data at rest in EU), low-latency SLAs for APAC region, and limited annotated data (~3k utterances per locale).

Initial model-fit readout (what we'd recommend for evaluation)
- Baseline candidate: Llama-2-13B-int8 (fast, good zero-shot) — suggested for broad coverage and throughput testing.
- Locale-specialist candidate: Mistral-7B-multilang-q4 (strong for European morphologies in our internal tests).
- High-quality candidate: RedOpt-14B-quant (higher per-token cost but noticeably better entity coherence in Japanese/Korean on our holdouts).

Why these? We ran a quick internal pass on a small sample of your anonymized snippets (thank you) and saw complementary strengths: Baseline for throughput, specialist for EU languages, high-quality for APAC morphologies.

Attachments / artifacts (attached to this thread)
- linguamar_promptset_v1.xlsx — canonical prompts + evaluation checklist per locale
- benchmark_summary_eu_apac.csv — summary of our quick internal pass (small sample)
- linguamar_sample_payloads.zip — sanitized example utterances you provided

Proposed next steps (timeline)
1) You: confirm priority locales and provide any additional sample utterances we should include (ideally another 2–3k per priority locale). (ETA: 3 business days)
2) Redwood: run a 7–10 day evaluation across the three candidate configurations (we’ll produce per-locale metrics, confusion matrices and failure-mode examples). We’ll also provide per-token cost estimates and latency profiles (ETA: 10 business days after we have final sample set).
3) Joint tech call: 45 min with Stephanie (runtime engineer) to confirm residency and integration requirements; Neha will drive procurement + sandbox access.

Open questions we raised on call
- Do you need an on-premises/private deployment for EU-only residency or will a VPC/region-bound private deployment suffice?
- Any regulatory constraints beyond data residency (e.g., deletion timelines, audit copies)?

I’ll hold a calendar block for the tech call next week. If the above reads correctly, reply with the confirmed priority languages and we’ll kick off the formal eval.

Thanks —
Jonas
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachment: linguamar_promptset_v1.xlsx (Excel, 82KB)
Attachment: benchmark_summary_eu_apac.csv (CSV, 48KB)
Attachment: linguamar_sample_payloads.zip (ZIP, 1.2MB)

From: Claudia Martin <claudia.martin@linguamar.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@linguamar.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Model-fit gap analysis & evaluation plan (EU / APAC locales)

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful and aligns with what our PMs want to see. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Priority locales: FR, DE are top priority for Q1; JP and KR are medium (Q2).
2) Residency: for EU enterprise customers we need data-at-rest in the EU; the VPC/private deployment you mentioned should be fine (on-prem is not necessary at this stage).
3) Timeline constraints: we have an internal demo window on 2027-01-18 — would like results before then if possible.

I’ve attached a small dev payload set (anonymized) that includes more conversational turns per locale — filename: linguamar_additional_sample_v2.zip. We cannot share PII; the set is sanitized.

Also, can you confirm whether the evaluation harness can produce per-intent misclassification examples and a ranked list of examples for manual review? That will be key for our annotation team.

— Claudia
Product Lead, LinguaMar AI
claudia.martin@linguamar.ai

Attachment: linguamar_additional_sample_v2.zip (ZIP, 930KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Martin <claudia.martin@linguamar.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Model-fit gap analysis & evaluation plan (EU / APAC locales)

Claudia — great, and thanks for the v2 bundle. A few operational notes from procurement/engagement: 

• Sandbox options: we can provision a Dedicated sandbox in the EU region scoped to your account for the evaluation period (no shared data). That meets the data-at-rest requirement you described.
• Pricing: for a 10-day eval across the three candidate configs I’ll put together a short estimate (includes token usage + reserved infra buffer).
• Compliance: we’ll provide SOC2 summary and our standard DP/retention matrix; if you need a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) redline we can start that in parallel.

Next steps for us: Jonas + Stephanie will set the evaluation spec (prompts / metrics / failure-mode tags). I’ll circulate a short SOW and the eval pricing by Monday (2026-11-16).

If anyone on the LinguaMar side prefers a dedicated Slack channel for faster triage during the eval, we can set that up — we’ve found it helps with quick clarification of failure examples.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Martin <claudia.martin@linguamar.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Model-fit gap analysis & evaluation plan (EU / APAC locales)

Thanks all — quick updates and commitments: 

- Commitment: we’ll start the formal eval once Claudia confirms the final sample set (including v2). Targeted 7–10 business day run after receipt. Aim is to deliver the per-locale metrics and failure-mode ranked examples no later than 2026-12-22 to give you time before the 2027-01-18 demo.

- Benchmarks and monitoring: the evaluation will publish a live dashboard (link below) with per-intent confusion matrices, ranked failure examples for manual review, and an automatic regression detector that will flag any model-version drop >3% absolute on the primary intent F1. We’ll also push the promptset and eval harness to the Drive folder so your annotation team can pull ranked examples directly.

- Privacy & infra: Stephanie will confirm the VPC sandbox setup and locality controls on Monday. We can also run a small on-prem pilot if later required, but for the trial the EU VPC-bound sandbox meets requirements.

Action items (owners)
• Claudia: confirm v2 final sample set and desired export format (jsonl/csv). (Owner: Claudia; ETA: Tue 2026-11-17)
• Neha: send SOW and eval pricing. (Owner: Neha; ETA: Mon 2026-11-16)
• Stephanie & Jonas: finalize eval spec and kick off infra provisioning once Claudia confirms. (ETA: Wed 2026-11-18)

Links: dashboard + artifacts
- Benchmark dashboard: https://redwood-internal.example.com/benchmarks/linguamar-2026
- Prompt & checks (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cLinguaMar-eval
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the tech call and a proposed SOW from Neha once she shares the pricing. Appreciate the quick turnaround here — we’ll keep the eval focused on actionable failure modes and clear pass/fail thresholds.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
